common.tagline: One account for every Tretu app: tretu.de, Saga, Play, Hollowmere and Minecraft.
common.genericError: That didn't work. Please try again.
common.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait a moment and try again.

login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: With your Tretu account, in every Tretu app.
login.magicLinkText: We'll send you a link that signs you in without a password.
login.magicLinkSent: If there is an account with this address, the link is on its way. It is valid for 10 minutes.
login.otherAccount: Sign in with a different account

errors.notVerified: Please confirm your email address first. We just sent you a new link.
errors.two_factor_required: Two-step verification is on for this account. Please sign in with your password and code, or with a passkey.
errors.passkey: Signing in with a passkey didn't work.
errors.invalid_token: This link is invalid or has expired. Please request a new one.
errors.expired: Signing in took too long. Please go back to the app and start again.
errors.locked: Too many failed attempts. The account is locked for a short while.
errors.account_not_linked: This account isn't linked to your Tretu account yet. Sign in and connect it under "Connected accounts".
errors.steam_failed: Signing in with Steam didn't work. Please try again.
errors.state_mismatch: The sign-in was started in another tab or browser, or took too long. Please try again.
errors.signup_disabled: There is no Tretu account for this login yet.
errors.accountLocked: Your Tretu account is locked. If you have questions about this, please contact the Tretu team.
errors.accountLockedUntil: Your Tretu account is locked until {until}. If you have questions about this, please contact the Tretu team.

notices.verified: Your email address is confirmed. Welcome to Tretu!
notices.reset: Your password has been changed. You can sign in now.
notices.deleted: Your account has been deleted. Sorry to see you go!
notices.signedOut: You have been signed out everywhere.

register.title: Create account
register.subtitle: One account for tretu.de, Saga, Play, Hollowmere and Minecraft.
register.usernameHint: 3–24 characters: letters, digits, _ and -. Used in every Tretu app.
register.displayNameHint: How others see you. Optional – otherwise your username.
register.passwordHint: At least 10 characters. A sentence only you know works well.
register.legal: By signing up you accept the <terms>terms</terms> and the <privacy>privacy policy</privacy>.
register.doneText: We sent an email to {email}. Click the link in it to confirm your account.
register.doneHint: No email? Check your spam folder or request a new link.

errors.usernameInvalid: Usernames have 3–24 characters: letters, digits, _ and -.
errors.passwordShort: The password must have at least 10 characters.
errors.passwordCompromised: This password appears in known data breaches. Please choose another one.
errors.emailInvalid: Please enter a valid email address.
errors.captcha: Please confirm that you are human.

forgot.title: Forgot password
forgot.subtitle: We'll send you a link to set a new password.
forgot.sent: If there is an account with this address, the link is on its way. It is valid for one hour.

reset.title: New password
reset.subtitle: Choose a new password for your Tretu account. All your other devices will be signed out.
reset.invalid: This link is invalid or has expired. Please request a new one.

verify.title: Confirm your email
verify.subtitle: Click the link in the email we sent you.
verify.resent: If this address belongs to an unconfirmed account, a new link is on its way.

twoFactor.title: Two-step verification
twoFactor.subtitle: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
twoFactor.subtitleBackup: Enter one of your backup codes. Each code works only once.
twoFactor.useTotp: Use a code from the app
twoFactor.invalid: The code is incorrect. Please try again.
twoFactor.expired: Signing in has expired. Please sign in again.
twoFactor.subtitleProvider: Almost there: your account is protected with two-step verification.
twoFactor.reused: This code was already used. Please wait for the next code in your app.

consent.title: Allow access?
consent.subtitle: {client} wants to use your Tretu account.

scopes.profile: username, display name, profile picture and language
scopes.offline_access: access while you are not signed in
scopes.tretu: your roles and connected accounts (Discord, Minecraft, Steam, TeamSpeak)

continuePage.usernameText: Your previous name is already taken on Tretu. We made a suggestion – you can change it once for free now.
continuePage.adminText: As an admin you must turn on two-step verification before you can sign in to Tretu apps.

error.title: Something went wrong
error.subtitle: Signing in could not be completed.

codes.invalid_redirect: The app sent an invalid return address.
codes.invalid_client: This app is not known to Tretu.
codes.state_mismatch: Signing in was started in another tab or browser. Please try again.
codes.account_already_linked_to_different_user: This account is already linked to another Tretu account. If it belongs to an old account of yours, contact us on Discord and we will merge the accounts.
codes.email_doesn't_match: The email address doesn't match your Tretu account.
codes.unable_to_link_account: The account could not be linked.
codes.email_not_found: The provider didn't send us an email address.
codes.signup_disabled: There is no Tretu account for this sign-in yet.
codes.default: Please try again. If it happens again, let us know on Discord.
codes.steam_failed: Steam could not confirm the sign-in. Please try again.
codes.steam_already_linked: Your Tretu account is already connected to another Steam account. Disconnect it first under “Connected accounts”.

account.title: My account
account.subtitle: Your Tretu account works in every Tretu app.
account.adminBanner: As an admin you need two-step verification to sign in to Tretu apps.
account.usernameBanner: Your old username was already taken. You can choose your new name once for free.

profile.title: Profile
profile.description: How others see you in every Tretu app.
profile.usernameHint: Your profile: tretu.de/u/{username}. You can change the name every 30 days.
profile.avatarHint: PNG, JPG or WebP, up to 2 MB. Cropped to a square.
profile.changeEmailSent: Almost done: please confirm the change with the link we sent you.

errors.usernameInvalid: Usernames have 3–24 characters: letters, digits, _ and -.
errors.usernameTooSoon: You can change your username again from {date}.
errors.nameInvalid: Please enter a display name with 1–64 characters.
errors.avatarInvalid: Please choose a PNG, JPG or WebP image up to 2 MB.
errors.emailTaken: This email address is already in use.

security.passwordDescription: Sign in with username or email and password.
security.passwordNone: You don't have a password yet. Set one to also sign in without Discord, Google, Apple, Steam or a passkey.
security.passwordChanged: Password changed. Other devices have been signed out.
security.passkeysDescription: Sign in with your fingerprint, face or device PIN – no password. Works in every Tretu app.
security.passkeyFailed: The passkey could not be added.
security.twoFactorDescription: Every sign-in without a passkey – with a password, Discord, Google, Apple, Steam or a sign-in link – also asks for a code from your authenticator app.
security.twoFactorScan: Scan the QR code with your authenticator app (e.g. 1Password, Google Authenticator, Aegis) and enter the code it shows.
security.twoFactorEnabled: Two-step verification is now on. From now on every sign-in without a passkey asks for a code.
security.backupCodesText: Keep these codes safe. Each one works once if you can't access your app.
security.sessionsDescription: Devices you are currently signed in on.
security.signOutEverywhereText: Signs you out on every device and in every Tretu app.
security.activityDescription: Sign-ins and changes to your account in the last 90 days.
security.passwordNeedsEmail: Signing in with a password needs a confirmed email address. We'll send you a confirmation link – afterwards you sign in with your username or email and password.
security.passwordSetConfirmEmail: Password saved. Please confirm {email} with the link we sent you – signing in with the password works after that.

connections.title: Connected accounts
connections.description: Sign in with these accounts. Tretu apps can use connected accounts for features like roles or stats.
connections.lastMethod: This is your only way to sign in. Set a password or add a passkey first.
connections.gamesDescription: Connect Minecraft and TeamSpeak on the server or on tretu.de, Steam right here.
connections.reauth: For your security, please sign in again and then try once more.

hints.minecraft: Type /dashboard in the game on our Minecraft server and sign in with your Tretu account.
hints.teamspeak: Put the code from tretu.de into your TeamSpeak nickname and your TeamSpeak account gets connected.
hints.steam: Afterwards you can also sign in with Steam.

errors.account_already_linked_to_different_user: This Steam account is already connected to another Tretu account.
errors.steam_already_linked: Your Tretu account is already connected to another Steam account. Disconnect it first.
errors.steam_failed: Steam could not confirm the connection. Please try again.
errors.state_mismatch: Connecting took too long or was started in another tab. Please try again.

language.title: Language
language.description: Every Tretu app shows its interface and sends you emails in this language.

privacy.exportText: A JSON file with everything your Tretu account stores about you: profile, connected accounts, sessions, passkeys (without keys), app grants and activity.
privacy.deleteText: Your Tretu account is deleted for good and you are signed out everywhere. Every Tretu app is notified and deletes or anonymises your data there. This cannot be undone.
privacy.deleteReauth: For your security you must have signed in recently. Please sign out and in again.

verifyEmail.subject: Confirm your email address
verifyEmail.intro: welcome to Tretu! Please confirm your email address to get your account ready. The link is valid for 24 hours.

resetPassword.subject: Your new Tretu password
resetPassword.intro: someone (hopefully you) wants to reset the password of your Tretu account. The link is valid for one hour.

magicLink.subject: Your Tretu sign-in link
magicLink.intro: here is your link to sign in to Tretu. It is valid for 10 minutes and works only once.

changeEmail.subject: Confirm your new email address
changeEmail.intro: you want to change the email address of your Tretu account to {newEmail}. Please confirm with the button.

accountDeleted.subject: Your Tretu account has been deleted
accountDeleted.intro: your Tretu account has just been deleted and you were signed out everywhere. The Tretu apps delete or anonymise your data. Thanks for being with us!
